subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: Should a configured browser image-understanding failure deliberately return only text and an explicit share hint, rather than preserve the prior raw-image recovery fallback?
rationale: The branch fixes a demonstrated session-state failure, but it intentionally changes what an existing configured-vision user can recover from a transient provider failure; repository policy treats fallbacks as a product decision.

options.title: Accept the text-only fallback
options.body: Approve the proposed contract: prevent session contamination and require an explicit message-tool share when configured vision fails.

options.title: Preserve raw-image recovery
options.body: Keep or redesign a raw-image recovery path, but only with a session-safe mechanism that cannot retain base64 image blocks in subsequent tool context.

recommendation.title: Accept the text-only fallback
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed contract: prevent session contamination and require an explicit message-tool share when configured vision fails.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the affected browser screenshot behavior and can choose the intended failure-recovery contract.
